newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRCI led group to take 98 pct of Ebecom.
newsitem.headline: PRCI led group to take 98 pct of Ebecom.

text.p: Philippine Racing Club Inc (PRCI) is leading a consortium of local companies buying a 98 percent stake in Ebecom Holdings Inc, a joint disclosure by PRCI and Ebecom released on Friday said.

Ebecom executive vice president Ramon Ereneta said under the memorandum of agreement signed by the parties late on Thursday, the consortium would pay for the stake by transferring 10.388 billion pesos worth of properties to Ebecom.
PRCI, together with Sta Lucia Realty & Development Inc, ACL Development Corp and Central Vegetable Oil Manufacturing Co Inc would subscribe to 577,151,567 Ebecom shares.
The properties are a 25.8 hectare lot in the Manila's Makati business district, a 147-hectare lot just outside Manila, a 22,865 square metre lot and a 16.624 square metre lot, both in Manila.
